arb-scanner.description: Develops and maintains the Web3 Sports Betting Arbitrage Telegram Bot. Use for building scanner features, fixing arb math bugs, running syntax checks, and deploying to Railway.

syntax-check.description: Run syntax check on all JS files
syntax-check.prompt: Run 'node -c bot.js && node -c arbitrage.js && node -c oddsFetcher.js && node -c database.js && node -c aiAnalyzer.js && node -c config.js'

deploy-check.description: Verify project is ready for Railway deployment
deploy-check.prompt: 1) Check .env.example has all env vars from config.js 2) Run syntax check on all JS files 3) Check package.json has telegraf and sql.js 4) Verify Procfile and railway.json exist

add-sport.description: Add a new sport to the odds scanner
add-sport.prompt: 1) Add sport key/name to SPORTS array in oddsFetcher.js 2) Verify the sport key matches OddsPapi format 3) Run syntax check

generate-report.description: Generate daily/weekly performance report from database
generate-report.prompt: Read the recent bets from database.js, calculate P&L, and format a report
